descriptionChirho: Adjective describing what is agreeable, lovely, or pleasing to the senses or spirit. Used predicatively of dwelling together in unity (Ps 133:1 'how pleasant!'), of praising God (Ps 135:3; 147:1), of wise words kept ready on the lips (Prov 22:18; 24:4), of a beloved's beauty (Song 1:16), and substantively of David as 'the pleasant one of Israel's songs' (2 Sam 1:23). Also in plural for pleasant things or people (Prov 23:8). Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm: Ar. ladhdh/latif, Ger. lieblich, Sp. agradable, Hin. ananddayak/suhavne, Kor. areumdaun/jeulgeoun.
